LightMessage.sunsetDim: The sun sets and the light begins to fade.
LightMessage.nightDark: Night fully settles over the surroundings.

Dim.Text: This token has no detected low-light or darkvision capability. Apply the active game system's dim-light rules.

Dark.Text: This token has no detected darkvision capability. Apply the active game system's darkness rules.

VisionWarnings.Name: Show Vision Rule Warnings
VisionWarnings.Hint: Show token warnings when dim light or darkness exceeds a creature's vision.

CalendarNotifications.Name: Post Calendar and Light Messages
CalendarNotifications.Hint: Post messages for month, season, and light-phase changes.

EmphasizeTimeJumps.Name: Emphasize Deliberate Large Time Jumps
EmphasizeTimeJumps.Hint: Large discrete time jumps enlarge the clock; continuous and combat-driven updates do not.

EmphasisMinimumSeconds.Name: Minimum Time Jump for Emphasis (seconds)
EmphasisMinimumSeconds.Hint: Smaller updates move the hands normally without enlarging the clock.

CalendarNotice.GenericYear: The world enters {year}, with a new year of stories yet to unfold.
CalendarNotice.GenericMonth: The world enters {month}, and the calendar opens onto new journeys.
CalendarNotice.GenericSeason: The seasons turn, and the world enters {season}.

Seasons.spring: Snow melts and green shoots return. The world enters spring.
Seasons.summer: Sunlight grows stronger and life flourishes. The world enters summer.
Seasons.autumn: Grain ripens and leaves turn gold. The world enters autumn.
Seasons.winter: Cold winds cross the land, and life grows quiet. The world enters winter.

PF2Months.1: The world enters Abadius. Merchants and cities greet the first trade of the new year.
PF2Months.2: The world enters Calistril. The Inner Sea endures winter’s cold as spring draws near.
PF2Months.3: The world enters Pharast. Pharasma watches over endings and the first life of spring.
PF2Months.4: The world enters Gozran. Gozreh’s wind and rain sweep the coasts and stir the land.
PF2Months.5: The world enters Desnus. Warm, gentle days invite travelers onto Desna’s roads.
PF2Months.6: The world enters Sarenith. Sarenrae’s sunlight fills the long days of summer.
PF2Months.7: The world enters Erastus. Crops begin to bear fruit, and farmers and hunters grow busy.
PF2Months.8: The world enters Arodus. People remember Aroden’s achievements and mourn his death.
PF2Months.9: The world enters Rova. Harvest celebrations begin, even as people prepare for the cold ahead.
PF2Months.10: The world enters Lamashan. Shadows lengthen, and monsters are seen more often at dusk.
PF2Months.11: The world enters Neth. As daylight fades, families and friends gather after the harvest.
PF2Months.12: The world enters Kuthona. The winter solstice brings the shortest days and the deepest dark.
